answer: The help center doesn't name any lenders outside the e-payoff network, so it doesn't cover which lenders in our records fall outside it; please contact a store for that. It only says that customers with any lender not on the network list must bring a payoff letter or sign NW-LPA-1 so we can request one. The network currently includes Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union, Lakeshore Bank, and Granite Bank, which joined on March 15, 2026. NW-LPA-1 applies to loans only; lease customers need a dealer payoff quote instead.
